Madam / Dear Sir, 
 
Sub:  Scheduling of Q2FY27 Earnings’ Audio Conference Call - Notice under Regulation 
30(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
read with Schedule III A (15) ibid 
 
In continuation of our earlier letter no.: HO/SEC/ 191 /2026-27 dated October 16, 2026, 
regarding intimation on convening the Board Meeting for considering the unaudited, 
reviewed Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year 
ended September 30, 2026 of the Bank, we further inform that an Audio Conference Call 
with Analysts / Institutional Investors will be held on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at                 
04:00 PM IST.
